discovery.instructions: Review official free US job sources, rights, attribution, robots, limits and history. Record evidence and changes; do not contact suppliers, purchase, ingest or enable a new source automatically.

sources.name: NYC DCAS · Jobs NYC

sources.permission: NYC Open Data FAQ permits unrestricted reuse; public-policy manual requires provenance/version/modification identification when requested and disclaims completeness. No dataset-specific license recorded. Private evaluation only in this release; publication is a separate quality/rights decision.
sources.history: Upstream updates weekly and may overwrite history. Latest 20 external posting rows examined; observed versions only. Do not infer closure from absence.
sources.description_policy: Public open-data description, qualifications and application instructions as plain text; maximum 20000 characters, seven-day POC retention.
